name: darmm-embed-kazakh-v2
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of BAAI/bge-m3 (XLM-R backbone), not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568B parameters (identical tensor set), 1024 dims. Trained 1 epoch over 373k pairs, max_seq 192, MultipleNegativesRankingLoss. Recorded as a contender because it publishes retrieval metrics against its own base on the same held-out pairs; rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Caveats printed by the card: 192-token training pairs, mined WikiMatrix kk-ru alignments carry noise, legal/medical jargon underrepresented. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-07.

benchmarks.name: Kazakh retrieval Recall@1
benchmarks.config: Card table '| metric | **this model** | BAAI/bge-m3 | darmm-embedding-multilingual (v1) |', row 'kk retrieval Recall@1': 0.716 vs 0.666, same table. Card prints fractions; multiplied by 100 here. Held-out Kazakh pairs from Darmm/darmm-kk-retrieval-pairs via the repo's own eval_embed.py; self-scored.

benchmarks.name: Kazakh->Russian Accuracy@1
benchmarks.config: Same table: 0.668 vs 0.518. Cross-lingual transfer is the largest gain. Card caveat: kk-ru pairs come from mined WikiMatrix alignments and carry noise.

benchmarks.name: Kazakh->English Accuracy@1
benchmarks.config: Same table: 0.918 vs 0.851. Card caveat: trained on 192-token pairs, so long-passage quality is inherited from bge-m3 rather than tuned.
